--- a/debian/apparmor-profile
+++ b/debian/apparmor-profile

   #include <abstractions/base>
   #include <abstractions/kerberosclient>

@@ -16,6 +17,7 @@

   @{PROC}/[0-9]*/net/psched r,
   @{PROC}/[0-9]*/status r,
 
@@ -42,7 +44,7 @@
   /var/lib/sss/* rw,

 sssd (2.6.3-1ubuntu3.2) jammy; urgency=medium
